articles.title: Verify SMN backups
articles.searchText: verify smn backups prerequisites access to backup features requires the appropriate account permissions steps open settings maintenance open the backup tab when it is available to your account review the archive inventory statuses and verification results if authorized start a backup from the business interface and verify its outcome manually mark backup done once your procedure has been checked restore safeguards an available or verified backup does not mean restoration is authorized follow smn s displayed security checks do not replace the user interface with manual commands help checklist progress is local to the browser and is not included in backup archives

articles.title: Prepare the team calendar
articles.searchText: prepare the team calendar prerequisites a team must exist editing requires the appropriate privileges steps open the team calendar and select your team context review displayed days cycle periods absences and available calendar data check individual calendars and assignments under team members if the installation includes a scrum team an administrator may access working day settings this screen is not meant for kanban only installations check results after making changes in the business screens then manually mark calendar done note absences public holidays and availability can differ between team members viewing a calendar does not automatically verify capacity

articles.title: Review general settings
articles.searchText: review general settings prerequisites you need permission to access settings editing them requires appropriate privileges normally administrator rights steps open general settings review the fields and options actually shown by the form change the required options and use the screen s save action check the feedback and where useful reload the page to verify the values manually mark the general step done in the help center result the business screen saves settings not the help center users without the necessary permissions must not attempt configuration changes

articles.title: Prepare Kanban periods
articles.searchText: prepare kanban periods prerequisites you need access to a kanban team managing periods requires the appropriate permissions steps open kanban periods review existing periods and the selected team context if authorized use the period creation form verify displayed details and dates after saving manually mark cadence done once the periods are ready scrum and kanban a kanban period is not a scrum sprint help does not create any period

articles.title: Configure members and assignments
articles.searchText: configure members and assignments prerequisites a team must exist viewing members requires access permission changes require management rights steps open team members select the appropriate team when several are available review active and inactive members where permitted add or edit member profiles and assignments using the available forms verify assignment dates and calendars before considering the task completed manually mark members done in the checklist check a saved member may not yet have the correct assignment dates help never adds members itself

articles.title: First-time configuration of SMN
articles.searchText: first time configuration of smn this guide covers your first steps with scrum master notebook after installation reading a help article does not change any business data before signing in install smn from the windows distribution and launch it using the supplied launcher open the local address displayed by the launcher follow the installation s initial setup and first administrator account screens when needed this happens before the help center is available sign in business configuration requires the appropriate account permissions first configuration after sign in general review general settings as an administrator team create a team under settings teams if authorized calendar check the team calendar and applicable working days members check member profiles and assignments in team members cadence prepare sprints for scrum or kanban periods for kanban use the workflow for your team s mode tickets review tickets after selecting a team and cycle reports open reports when the required data is available backup inspect backup features under maintenance if permitted these are real application screens some are unavailable without administration permissions the checklist limits its steps based on your rights and agile mode do not use an administrative action unless you are authorized track your progress you manually choose to do in progress or done self declared for each applicable step reading help never marks a step as done the counter shows your declarations not automatic validation by smn progress is stored only in the browser profile for this smn origin it is not transferred to another computer or included in smn backups backup and restore a backup archive alone does not authorize restoration check the verification status and security prerequisites under maintenance before taking action

articles.title: Explore reports
articles.searchText: explore reports prerequisites you need a signed in account an accessible team and suitable reporting data steps open reports review the available tabs and templates according to your permissions select the team and cycle if prompted by the page view existing documents if authorized use the available creation features check the outcome before manually marking reports done important an available template does not guarantee that the required data is present help never generates documents on your behalf

articles.title: Prepare your first Scrum sprint
articles.searchText: prepare your first scrum sprint prerequisites you need access to a scrum team creation operations require appropriate privileges this guide does not apply to kanban steps open sprints select the relevant scrum team review existing sprints or use the generation action if you are an administrator check cadence dates and statuses before confirming a business operation verify the sprint in the list afterwards and manually mark cadence done note smn may redirect to the home page when scrum mode or permissions are unavailable the help center does not generate sprints

articles.title: Create a team
articles.searchText: create a team prerequisites an authorized administrator should first review general settings steps open settings teams use the create team button in the page header complete the fields shown in the form including the name and agile mode when offered save then verify that the team appears in the list return to the checklist and declare team done when the team actually exists scrum or kanban the team s mode controls which screens and features apply sprints belong to scrum kanban periods belong to kanban help never creates a team on your behalf

articles.title: Tickets
articles.searchText: tickets the tickets module provides access to features related to csv ticket snapshots access open tickets from the main navigation review the actions available under your account permissions this introduction does not replace the detailed csv import guide which will be written against the implemented behavior
